hooks.command: if [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = "true" ]; then if ! command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.deno/bin/deno" ]; then curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s v2.9.4 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ]; then echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.deno/bin:$PATH"' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi; fi; exit 0
